title: Veer Bhimsen
overview: Veer Bhimsen (1964) is a mythological Hindi action film directed by Chandrakant, starring action legend Dara Singh as Bhima and Mumtaz. The plot re-enacts episodes from the Hindu epic Mahabharata, highlighting Bhima's immense strength, his defense of the Pandavas against Kaurava injustices, and dramatic physical confrontations.
